acceptanceCriteria: Each frontier state with only a runtime-skipped case gains a producer-generated vector or the spec records why none can exist.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-1/wave-2 pull requests (#74-#82). Review of PR #79 (V1-0013): six manifest cases skip with capability `obligation-free-universe`; the relocated, `evidence-drift` and deleted states are pinned only at the CEM layer (CF-V0-034).
title: frontier: relocated and stale hostile vectors cannot be produced by real producers
